name: photo-ink-postcard
description: Turn landscape, human, or animal photography into adaptive 3:4 or 4:3 photo-and-ink postcards.

interface.shortDescription: 将风景摄影转为克制留白的摄影水墨明信片
interface.longDescription: 横图采用 3:4 上下双区，竖图采用 4:3 左右双区；实拍确定性保留，人物和动物主体以减法水墨重构。
defaultPrompt: 使用 photo-ink-postcard 将我附上的照片制作成自适应摄影水墨明信片。
Use photo-ink-postcard to turn my attached photo into an adaptive photo-and-ink postcard.
